verdict.rationale: The README says the coding agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests with `gh` (gh-5), which covers the PR half of the workflow. Nothing documents starting from a tracked issue (reading or linking GitHub issues, or closing them via the PR), and the claim is a single README line. Missing for 10: documented issue-to-PR intake (fetching or referencing tracked issues), in-depth workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
